parole.significato: The currency of Hawaii between 1847 and 1898, equal to the United States dollar.
parole.testo: From an unassimilated equivalent of Hawaiian kālā, from English dollar.

parole.significato: A person of mixed ethnic heritage, especially half East or Southeast Asian or Pacific Islander and half White.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Hawaiian hapa, from English half. Doublet of half.

From Hawaiian pīkake, itself from English peacock, see which for full derivation. Both Arabian jasmine and peacocks were associated with Princess Kaʻiulani, so they came to have the same name in Hawaiian.
